content: The National Standards for Diabetes Self-Management Education and Support (DSMES), as outlined by the American Diabetes Association (ADA), emphasize an integrated approach that combines clinical education, behavioral support, and psychosocial engagement. This comprehensive strategy is designed to holistically address the needs of individuals managing diabetes. With the increasing availability of digital health tools, DSMES programs are now able to reach a broader population through online platforms. This advancement has significantly improved accessibility, particularly for individuals who previously faced challenges related to geographic location or physical mobility. Specific strategies have been implemented to bridge the digital divide, including efforts to provide digital tools and resources to underserved and marginalized communities.
